paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.82% on average, with DAX strongest (+0.95%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.90%). Brent crude changed +3.35% to 109.47. Gold changed +0.25% to 4,180.3999. Bitcoin changed -0.97% to 81,347.5078. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.121%, a relative move of +0.63%. Among the firms tracked, EQT (+3.33%) and BP (+3.12%) moved the most.
